questions.prompt: According to your notes, three of these are types of plate boundary. Which one is not?

evidence.quote: Scientists group plate boundaries into three types.
A hotspot is not a type of plate boundary

pairs.right: Plates move apart and new crust forms

evidence.quote: At divergent boundaries, plates move apart and new crust forms
At convergent boundaries, plates move towards each other

pairs.right: Plates slide past each other sideways

questions.prompt: According to your notes, put the steps of subduction at an ocean-continent boundary in order.
steps: The denser oceanic plate bends downward beneath the continental plate
The sinking plate heats up as it descends into the mantle
Water from the sinking plate helps nearby mantle rock melt into magma
Magma rises and can erupt to form a line of volcanoes

evidence.quote: First, the denser oceanic plate bends downward beneath the continental plate.
Finally, the magma rises and can erupt to form a line of volcanoes

questions.explanation: Paragraph 6 gives the order with first, next, then, finally.

evidence.quote: When an oceanic plate meets a continental plate, subduction follows a typical order.

evidence.quote: The plates float on the asthenosphere
